# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 1894264887, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> an old printing press producing beautifully ordered pages decorated with curly brace ornaments, neat stacks of printed sheets, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark
